answer: Give every identity an unpredictable, per-identity challenge each epoch, its prompt seeded from the prior emission hash so it cannot be guessed ahead. To mint, the identity must forge a fresh answer bound to its own unguessable seed, machine-checked for required seeded tokens and hash-uniqueness against all other answers. A farm cannot pre-compute or share one ivory template across a flock of sparrow fakes — each faces a different, late-revealed prompt. Duplicate or seed-mismatched answers are rejected in replay, so one brain cannot cheaply voice a thousand names.
